overview_description.description:
Square is a software company that develops omnichannel solutions.

Square aims to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality through Afterpay, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

The company also embedded financial services tools at the point of sale for merchants to access a business loan and manage their cash flow.

product.description: A scheduling and point-of-sale system tailored for service businesses to manage bookings, payments, and client communications.

product.description: A tool for managing employee schedules, time tracking, payroll preparation, and sales reporting with customizable access permissions.

product.description: A prepaid card linked to a business’s Square balance allowing immediate access to funds from processed payments.
